messages:
yasmin (devex): quick one for eng: customer complains `redwoodctl login --headless` prints token but there's no documented safe way to persist it into a profile in CI. they ended up echoing into a file, feels fragile.
matt (eng-runtime): agreed — we used to have `profile import` but it's clunky for CI. what do they want?
yasmin (devex): they want a non-interactive flow: `redwoodctl login --headless --output-file /path/to/token` or a `--set-active` flag to create profile atomically.
jia (eng-platform): we actually have internal flag `--emit-token` but it's not in docs. leaking it is a security concern. we should add a safer `--write-profile` option that creates a profile file with tight perms (600) and optionally sets it active.
matt (eng-runtime): implementation notes: write atomic (tmp + rename), chmod 600, and return 0 only if write succeeded. Also support `--profile-name` and `--config-dir` to override XDG for CI.
yasmin (devex): great. can we also print a one-line CI snippet to stdout when run with `--ci-snippet`? e.g. `redwoodctl login --headless --write-profile --profile-name ci --ci-snippet` prints the shell commands to add to CI pipeline.
jia (eng-platform): fine but be careful not to print the raw token in logs. CI snippet should use file paths only. maybe `--ci-snippet` prints: `export RWCTL_CONFIG_DIR=/build/.redwood && redwoodctl profile use ci` and instructions.
matt (eng-runtime): i'll draft PR: add `--write-profile` and `--profile-name` + atomic write + perm fix. also add telemetry event for headless->file writes.
yasmin (devex): any short-term help for support to send?
matt (eng-runtime): workaround: `redwoodctl login --headless | jq -r .token > /tmp/rw-token && redwoodctl profile import --name ci --file /tmp/rw-token && rm /tmp/rw-token` — mention permissions and ephemeral files.
jia (eng-platform): i'll update docs and add a short CI example using GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. assign GH#5301 to matt.
diag-bot: created issue GH#5301: "add non-interactive profile write flow for headless login (CI-friendly)"
yasmin (devex): thanks! i'll add this to the quickstart CI appendix.
